statement: As stated, the original idea is not novel in its combined form: every component and the central comparative claim are already reported in arxiv:2609.12230, validated only on two disease-specific KGs with multiple-choice items. A defensible contribution must be re-scoped toward an independent controlled decomposition of component contributions, matched-token controls, and/or generalization to standard multi-hop KGQA benchmarks.

evidence.quote: Across both diseases, context-augmented supervision consistently improves multi-hop performance over KG-only supervision. RL initialized from repaired SFT checkpoints yields larger and more stable gains than RL initialized from unrepaired checkpoints.

We construct disease-specific Gastroparesis and Diabetes KG/CG datasets and generate structured multiple-choice QA items spanning 1-hop to 5-hop reasoning, grounded entirely in verifiable KG/CG paths.
